flawless: I feast on artifacts and on hope. Today you served me both.
Your soul smells of oil already. You will make a fine Phyrexian.
The Portal stays shut to you, little thing. It always will.
solid: You hurt me. Pain is Yawgmoth's gift, and I thank you for wrapping it.
I fed on my own machines to win. A small price for your defeat.
close: My machines are devoured and my wings in tatters. You would make a magnificent offering.
Closer than any mortal has come to my door. Yawgmoth will want to meet you.
